lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: name: vitadeck-manual-testing

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: description: Guides manual GUI testing of VitaDeck Deck Apps, Shell navigation, Runtime Upload, and walkthrough recording. Use when testing VitaDeck visually, using computerUse with the raylib window, validating Deck App rendering, or producing screenshots/videos for UI changes.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: metadata:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: internal: true

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: # VitaDeck manual testing

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Quick start

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 1. Build JavaScript and native first:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `pnpm --dir js build`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - macOS: `cmake -S . -B out && cmake --build out`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Linux/GCC: `CC=gcc CXX=g++ cmake -S . -B out -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,--start-group" && cmake --build out`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 2. Stage Deck Apps for local runs when `out/vitadeck-data` is missing or stale:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `cmake --build out --target stage_examples` copies every built example into `out/vitadeck-data/installed-deck-apps/`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Pick the one to run: `printf 'chat.vdapp\n' > out/vitadeck-data/active-package.txt`. Without this file the Shell opens with no Active Deck App.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 3. Run from `out/`, not the repo root:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `./vitadeck`

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Prefer a task-specific tmux session, e.g. `vitadeck-ui-demo`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 4. Use `computerUse` for the raylib window. Record only the final successful walkthrough.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Navigation map

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - **Start / F1** toggles between the running **Deck App** and the **VitaDeck Shell**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - In the **VitaDeck Shell**, **Enter** confirms and **Backspace** goes back.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The **Shell Home Screen** lists installed **Deck App Packages** plus **Upload**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Hiding the Shell should reveal the **Active Deck App**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - If key input seems ignored, first focus the VitaDeck window; then retry F1/Enter/Backspace.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Reliable local Deck App verification

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Use direct staging for deterministic UI tests. Runtime Upload is useful only when the upload flow itself is under test.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Checklist:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Confirm `js/examples/<name>/dist/<name>.vdapp/manifest.json` matches the expected package.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Confirm package assets exist, e.g. `js/examples/chat/dist/chat.vdapp/fonts/*.ttf`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Copy the built `.vdapp` directory into `out/vitadeck-data/installed-deck-apps/<name>.vdapp`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Set `out/vitadeck-data/active-package.txt` to that package name.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Restart `out/vitadeck` after changing staged package contents.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Inspect the tmux log for startup evidence such as loaded package fonts:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `tmux capture-pane -p -t vitadeck-ui-demo:0.0 -S -120`

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Runtime Upload testing

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Only use this when testing upload behavior:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 1. Open the **Shell** with F1.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 2. Select **Upload** and confirm.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 3. Prefer the known local endpoint while the upload screen is active:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `curl -X POST http://localhost:8787/upload -F archive=@js/examples/chat/dist/chat.vdapp.zip`

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 4. Verify upload actually replaced the package on disk before judging the UI:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `out/vitadeck-data/installed-deck-apps/<package>.vdapp/manifest.json`

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 5. If curl resets or hangs, inspect the app log. Do not assume the package changed.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Walkthrough recording pattern

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 1. Complete all setup before recording.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 2. Start recording.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 3. Ask `computerUse` to perform only the visual verification.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 4. Save the recording only if the walkthrough succeeds; otherwise discard it, fix the issue, and retry.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 5. For font or text changes, verify both:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - startup logs show the expected font/package loaded;

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - the rendered UI visibly demonstrates the requested typography.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Common pitfalls

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Running from the repo root makes `vitadeck` miss `js/runtime.js`; always run from `out/`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `pnpm --dir js build` rebuilds example `.vdapp` packages; it does not automatically update `out/vitadeck-data`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - A visible old UI usually means the installed package was not replaced or the app was not restarted.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The listener falls forward to 8788-8796 when 8787 is busy; read the port from the URL on the Shell Upload Screen before curling.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not keep failed walkthrough recordings as artifacts.
